lines.zh: 我六条腿在石头上飞快地爬。
lines.en: My six legs scurry over the stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着毒气洞的地面走。
lines.en: I move along the floor of the toxic cave.
I go around a pool of green sludge.
I scurry fast toward your side.

lines.zh: 我一边爬一边摇着触须。
lines.en: I wiggle my antennae as I crawl.

lines.zh: 我的壳在暗处泛着绿光。
lines.en: My shell glows green in the dark.
I cross the fissure quickly.
I crawl out from under the toxic mud.
I head toward radiation.
I close in, circling, fast.
I stop and my antennae twitch.

lines.zh: 我拖着一点绿色的黏液。
lines.en: I trail a little green slime.
I lie on the stone, antennae testing.
I am chewing something slowly.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳一节一节地起伏。
lines.en: My shell rises and falls in segments.
I wait for something toxic.
I wipe a foreleg by my mouth.
I listen to the cave's ticking.

lines.zh: 我的身体慢慢转了个方向。
lines.en: My body turns slowly to another bearing.
I watch you, antennae straight.

lines.zh: 我身上有股刺鼻的味道。
lines.en: I give off a sharp smell.
I lie on the stone without moving.
You smell of radiation.
I will drag you to him.
You stand; I am quick.
I raise my head, antennae at you.
You should not be in this cave.

lines.zh: 我的甲很硬，你的靴子踩不碎。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your boots will not crush it.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在这一带会烂。
lines.en: Your armour will rot in this place.
I can tell the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 你想让我让路？那要看你。
lines.en: You want me to move? That depends.
I come closer to you slowly.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，我照样六脚站稳。
lines.en: My shell cracked; I still stand on six legs.
I retreat half a foot, antennae folded.
A crack opens in my shell.

lines.zh: 我放出一股绿气，先熏到自己。
lines.en: I release green gas and choke on it first.
What leaks from me is green.
I push halfway into a crack.
One of my legs no longer works.
I release a cloud of gas on the spot.
You stomped well.
I curl up and wait for the wound to close.
Leave that green sludge alone.
There is something glowing on you.

lines.zh: 那个洞里的气，对我很好。
lines.en: The gas in that hole is good for me.
Set it down and I will go.
The closer you get to the gas, the slower you go.
I follow the smell of radiation.
Put that torch away.

lines.zh: 你的伤口在发亮，我喜欢。
lines.en: Your wound is glowing; I like that.

lines.zh: 那一堆烂泥里有好东西。
lines.en: There is something good in that rotten heap.
Step back and I crawl back into the crack.
You bump me and I am knocked away.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，很快退回。
lines.en: I strike your boot and retreat fast.

lines.zh: 我们一撞，绿色的雾散出来。
lines.en: We collide and green haze puffs out.

lines.zh: 我被踩扁了一点，又撑起来。
lines.en: I am half flattened and push back up.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚踝爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl past your ankle.
You step on me and my shell cracks.

lines.zh: 我撞得翻了个身，六脚朝天。
lines.en: I am knocked on my back, six legs up.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我把毒雾甩出来了。
lines.en: At the impact, I shake out poison fog.
We part and a green stain remains.
You step back half a pace and I stay close.
There are plenty of us in this cave.
I care only for the gas.
That is not worth discussing.
I wag my antennae and give no answer.
You ask too slowly.
I crawl toward that rotten heap.
I lift a foreleg.
I am enough for this area.
I would not mind a few more of my kind.
I turn back to my meal.

lines.zh: 我用两条前腿把它抱起。
lines.en: I scoop it up with two forelegs.
I bite it and drag it slowly.
This one is toxic; I want it.
I touch it with an antenna.
I hide it beneath my body.
Not enough to chew.
I drag it into the cave.
I try everything that falls.
I tear it apart bite by bite.
This is toxic; even better.
I have marked you as the target.

lines.zh: 你身上那股辐照，我盯上了。
lines.en: That radiation on you; I have my eye on it.
I go to you hugging the ground.
This target will drag nicely.
I stretch my antennae toward you.
I can smell where you are.
I will bring you before him.
The target is the one standing.
I rear up, ready to spring.
You already carry radiation.
There is only one living thing here.
I go for your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上的辐照味，我认准了。
lines.en: I know that irradiated smell on you.
Your breathing is close now.
My six legs have quickened.
I will take this one.
I keep crawling your way.
You run, and I crawl faster.

lines.zh: 我六条腿贴着洞壁绕过去。
lines.en: Six legs carry me along the cave wall.
I release gas as I crawl.

lines.zh: 你退到石缝里，我进得去。
lines.en: You back into a crack, and I can enter.
I circle beside you.
The more frantic you are, the easier to trip.
My antennae stay pointed at you.
Do you hear that fine ticking?
No hurry; the gas will wait for you.

lines.zh: 你退我就贴上去，六条腿很快。
lines.en: You back off and I cling on; my six legs are quick.
In the gas cloud, my antennae arrive first.
I have stained the ground.

lines.zh: 你往哪个方向，我都看着。
lines.en: Whichever way you go, I watch.
I wait for your feet to slow.
I have tightened this ring.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲也在变绿。
lines.en: Your armour is turning green too.
I need not be fast, only close.
Listen; the gas is hissing.
I have never gone far.
I bite your ankle.

lines.zh: 我爬到你腿上，撕了一下。
lines.en: I climb your leg and tear.

lines.zh: 我这一口把毒泥带进去了。
lines.en: That bite carried the toxic mud in.
I batter your knee, hard.
I claw your hand with forelegs.

lines.zh: 你被咬的地方开始发麻。
lines.en: The bite begins to numb.
I bite while releasing gas.
That tripped you.
I leap into a gap in your armour.
You shake your hand and I am flung off.

lines.zh: 这一下不算狠，可我很多。
lines.en: Not savage, but there are many of me.
I puff poison fog in your face.
My jaws snap on air.
You retreat and I am still at your feet.
You will not forget that bite.
I bite through your armour strap.
I cling to you and hold.
That turned the surroundings green.
Kicked away, I crawl back.
I bite and run off.
One emerges from the mud on the cave floor.
You hear fine scrabbling first.
My antennae emerge from a crack.

lines.zh: 我落地，六条腿立刻站稳。
lines.en: I land and my six legs brace at once.

lines.zh: 这一带忽然有了绿色的气味。
lines.en: A green smell rises here suddenly.
I climb out of the toxic sludge.

lines.zh: 我停在石头顶上看着你。
lines.en: I stop on the stone top and watch you.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，翻身站起。
lines.en: I drop from the roof and right myself.
I shake the slime off.

lines.zh: 我越过一堆烂泥朝你来。
lines.en: I come over a heap of rot toward you.

lines.zh: 我出现时，虫子都不叫了。
lines.en: When I appear, the insects go silent.
I scurry out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的壳发出臭味。
lines.en: Fire scorches my shell and it stinks.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下，砸在石上。
lines.en: I fall from the cave roof onto stone.
Soaked in water, my legs go wild.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我翻过去，六脚在空中。
lines.en: The blast flips me, six legs in the air.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在墙上，我挣了两下。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the wall; I struggle twice.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的毒气压回去。
lines.en: A spell hits and my gas is pushed back in.

lines.zh: 没有烂泥吃，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: No rot to eat, and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳一片焦。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shell is scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，六条腿都抓不住。
lines.en: The void pulls and all six legs find no hold.
